# Update deps: biome 2.4.8, TypeScript 6.0

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

## Summary
- Bump `@biomejs/biome` from ^2.4.7 to ^2.4.8 (+ update schema version in biome.jsonc)
- Bump `typescript` from ^5.0.0 to ^6.0.0 in sdk-ecalli-mocks
- Adapt `tsconfig.json` for TypeScript 6 breaking changes (module/moduleResolution → nodenext, explicit rootDir)
- Fix new `noSubstr` lint rule: replace `substring()` with `slice()` in `sdk/core/bytes.ts`

## Test plan
- [x] `npm run qa` passes (biome CI clean)
- [x] `npm test` passes (all 115 tests: 79 SDK + 5 fibonacci + 31 ecalli)
- [x] `npm run build` succeeds (mocks + both examples + PVM compilation)
- [x] Pre-push hooks pass

This pull request updates build tooling and dependencies across multiple configuration files.
